LanguageData.UESDdebuger.SettingsHeader: Project configuration (MCP/config.json) and tool toggles (MCP/toolConfig.json). Closing this window saves; the MCP server needs to be restarted to take effect.
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ButtonShowAnnouncements: Show configuration announcements again (does not modify configuration)
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolSectionHeader: Tool toggles (toolConfig.json tools) — uncheck to disable; agg_call_tool can still invoke disabled tools
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.DialogCopyButton: Copy selected IDE configuration to clipboard
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.DialogChangelogEmpty: (No update notes for the current version)
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.agg_list_tools: Aggregation meta-tool: lists all tools with [enabled]/[disabled] status, including tools hidden by compressed mode
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.agg_call_tool: Aggregation meta-tool: invokes any tool directly by name — including tools disabled (unchecked) in this list; only agg_call_tool itself needs to be enabled
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.mcp_help: Query usage instructions for any tool (parameters/prerequisites/examples)
LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.start_game: Start RimWorld and wait for the main menu to be ready

LanguageData.UESDdebuger.ToolDesc.start_quick_test: Trigger quick-test map load and wait for map loading to complete
